name: Any Steam game (SteamCMD)
description: Install any dedicated server that lives on Steam by entering its App ID, then point the start command at the server binary. Covers every game that has a SteamCMD server build.

variables.name: STEAM_APPID
variables.label: Steam App ID
variables.description: Find it on steamdb.info — e.g. 896660 for Valheim.

variables.name: STEAM_LOGIN
variables.label: Steam login
variables.description: Most dedicated servers allow anonymous. Games that do not cannot be installed unattended.

variables.name: LAUNCH_BINARY
variables.label: Server binary
variables.description: Path to the executable inside the server directory.
